methodology: Static real-scene RenderPass GPU time: 32 EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 samples per view before/after. Times are stage times, not FPS or whole-frame medians.

Frozen A/B: actual Near geometry, matrices, attributes, material uniforms and camera, isolated from other passes; float HDR target. Baseline, early vertex-exit prototype, compact draw, repeated baseline; 32 GPU samples each.

Final compact draw uses the exact slot list selected by the production culler, preserving slot order. Frozen output comparison covers all HDR components; independent browser regression also compares depth across turns, rebasing and geometry replacement.

Moving stress: 64 actual application frames; translate 2 scene units (4000 km) while turning 360 degrees, with original view restored afterwards. No matching pre-change moving run, so it establishes remaining load, not a measured regression.
CPU Near visibility samples include bounds tests and compact-buffer preparation during normal application updateView.
Inspection histograms use approximate projected conservative sphere sizes; they are not pixel coverage. Per-allocation records omitted, source report hashes retained.
GPU outliers are retained. Median stage times are not summed into a claimed whole-frame median.
